Title: Register valid new user
Steps and test data: POST /api/auth/register with name email password and optional currency
Expected result: HTTP 201; response has safe user and token; password is absent; one default Cash account is created

Title: Register with a required field missing
Preconditions: Unauthenticated; use a unique email for each attempt
Steps and test data: Submit registration three times: omit name, then omit email, then omit password; provide the other valid fields each time
Expected result: Each request returns HTTP 400; no user or default account is created for any attempt

Title: Register a duplicate email
Preconditions: A user already exists for the test email
Steps and test data: POST /api/auth/register again with the same email and otherwise valid name/password
Expected result: HTTP 400; no second user or default account is created

Title: Register with malformed email
Steps and test data: POST /api/auth/register with name password and malformed email such as user-at-example
Expected result: Request is rejected with a 4xx response and no user or default account is created

Title: Register with password below minimum
Steps and test data: POST /api/auth/register with valid name/email and a five-character password
Expected result: Request is rejected with a 4xx response; no user or default account is created

Title: Register at minimum password length
Steps and test data: POST /api/auth/register with valid name/email and a six-character password
Expected result: HTTP 201; safe user and token returned; exactly one default Cash account created

Title: Login with valid credentials
Preconditions: User created by a successful registration
Steps and test data: POST /api/auth/login with registered email and correct password
Expected result: HTTP 200; safe user and JWT returned; password is not returned

Title: Login with incorrect password
Steps and test data: POST /api/auth/login with the user's email and an incorrect password
Expected result: HTTP 401 with a generic authentication message; no token returned

Title: Call protected account endpoint without token
Call protected account endpoint with invalid or expired token
List own accounts and total
Preconditions: Authenticated user with known account balances
Steps and test data: GET /api/accounts with valid bearer token; compare returned accounts and total with that user's records
Expected result: HTTP 200; only own accounts returned; total equals the sum of returned balances

Title: Create savings account
Steps and test data: POST /api/accounts with name QA Savings type savings and balance 0
Expected result: HTTP 201; returned account has valid type and authenticated user's userId

Title: Reject account without name
Steps and test data: POST /api/accounts with type cash and balance 0 but omit name

Title: Update own account details
Preconditions: Authenticated user with an existing account
Steps and test data: PUT /api/accounts/{ownAccountId} with a new name and supported type; verify balance before and after
Expected result: HTTP 200; supplied editable fields change; balance and owner remain unchanged

Title: Attempt to update another user's account
Preconditions: Two users; account owned by user B; token for user A
Steps and test data: PUT /api/accounts/{userBAccountId} with token for user A and a changed name

Title: Delete own account without transactions
Preconditions: Authenticated user with an empty account
Expected result: HTTP 200; account is removed from the user's account list

Title: Prevent deletion of account with transactions
Preconditions: Authenticated user with an account referenced by at least one transaction
Expected result: HTTP 400; account remains and its transaction reference is intact
